name: Cool chimps
summary:
In Cool Chimps, players are trapped in Chimp Safe, an abandoned nuclear bunker where failed experiments have given rise to intelligent and mutated chimps. What was once a refuge has become a deathtrap, and only the smartest and most resourceful can survive

Navigate through dark, claustrophobic corridors filled with hazards, solve challenging puzzles to unlock new areas, and use stealth to avoid detection by the chimps. Each decision matters as the chimps adapt to your behavior, making escape increasingly d
